status.W0: Branch: cells shift left; holes take a guess from their right.
status.W1: Refresh: shared cells copy the left again; holes keep R̂.
status.W2: New depth: most planks now shift 0 cells, so the band widens.
status.Wm: Last refresh: a seam inside the body also keeps R̂.
status.FINAL: Finished: the band shows wall the left view never saw.

status.W0: Branch: the guess smears the rack into brown streaks.
status.W1: Refresh: basket and rack copied again; the band keeps R̂.
status.W2: The donor now holds a round bottle holder inside the band.
status.Wm: Last refresh: the band and its holder are kept again.
status.FINAL: The holder and a bottle survive into the finished view.

status.default: Default: no smear or duplicate beside the pot.
status.m05: No refresh: shapes and background drift from the left view.
status.a20: Single warp at 20: a white smear and a faint duplicate beside the pot.
status.m40: Refreshing through step 40: the pot edge turns jagged.

status.default: Default: a small step remains in the back rim, outside the box.

status.a20: Single warp at 20: close to the default inside the box.
status.m40: Refreshing through step 40: the well rim turns striped.
